statement: Dell's results are reported to have reinforced NVIDIA's view that enterprise and hyperscaler spending on AI servers remains strong.
why: A server OEM's reported results are the nearest independent check on whether hyperscaler and enterprise AI capex is still converting into shipped systems.

impact.mechanism: Sustained AI-server orders at an OEM imply continued pull-through of merchant GPU shipments into enterprise and hyperscaler deployments.

evidence.excerpt: On demand: the article states Dell's results 'reinforced NVIDIA's view that enterprise and hyperscaler spending on AI servers remains strong.'

confidence.basis: Qualitative characterization in a single low-tier secondary aggregator; no Dell filing figure or NVIDIA disclosure is quoted.
